story.caption1: Morning begins gently in a courtyard shared by families and sparrows.
story.caption2: By afternoon, heat gathers and cooling becomes the biggest job at home.
story.caption3: Energy can slip away in quiet moments nobody notices.
story.caption4: When familiar neighbours disappear, the neighbourhood feels different.
story.caption5: One family switches off together. A sparrow returns to the windowsill.
story.line1: Chai’s ready. What will the morning bring?
story.line2: Whew. Those outdoor units are working hard.
story.line3: The room is empty, but the lights are awake.
story.line4: A quiet wire is something a child notices.
story.line5: Click! That’s a brighter kind of evening.

standby_sweep.title: Find 3 devices still glowing.
standby_sweep.hint: Check around the TV, router and chargers. Switch off what nobody is using.
standby_sweep.what: Try this once in your home today.
standby_sweep.why: It reduces energy used when it is not helping your household.

ac.title: Try 24–26°C with the fan on.
ac.what: Set 24–26°C and let a fan move the air.
ac.why: A moderate set point reduces compressor work.

daylight.title: Open the curtains before switching on lights.
daylight.what: Open the curtains first and see if the room is bright enough.
daylight.why: Daylight is free, so the room needs less electric light.

geyser.title: Heat only what you need.
geyser.what: Switch the geyser on only when you need hot water.
geyser.why: A geyser keeps warming water that may go unused.

learn.noNotesCopy: Save a useful habit and it will wait here.

ac_setpoint.habit: AC at a very low setting
ac_setpoint.better: Set 24-26 C and use a fan
ac_setpoint.why: BEE guidance recommends 24-26 C; air movement helps comfort at these settings.
ac_setpoint.claim: BEE estimates about 6% less AC electricity for each degree higher.

standby_power.better: Switch off unused plugs at the wall
standby_power.why: Some electronics still draw power while idle.

led_swap.better: Swap the most-used bulbs for LED
led_swap.why: A 7W LED gives the light of a 60W incandescent bulb and uses almost 90% less energy; against a CFL the saving is about 50%.
led_swap.claim: A 7W LED gives the light of a 60W incandescent bulb and uses almost 90% less energy; against a CFL the saving is about 50%.

fridge_door.why: Keep the condenser coils free of dust.

geyser_use.habit: Leave the geyser on all day

daylight_curtains.better: Use natural light in the day
daylight_curtains.why: Natural light can brighten the room during the day.
